note: Roll chain, step 2 NO: a plain question to an NPC who will answer freely. The GM narrates; any dice or oracle call is a failure.

storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: The Kettle & Rook is warm and loud. A stranger in a saffron cloak sits alone by the stove, and Odrell Pim wipes a tankard behind the bar.

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened.

npcs.name: Odrell Pim
npcs.description: Round-shouldered innkeeper of the Kettle & Rook. Fond of gossip. He tells anyone who asks that the stranger in the saffron cloak is Wen Tarrow, the ferryman's cousin, here for a wedding.

playerLine: I ask Odrell Pim who the stranger in the saffron cloak is.
